selection_rule: Frozen before the corpus was chosen. From `git log --first-parent main` in CHRONOLOGICAL order, a commit is eligible when: (1) its diff touches at least one _test.go and at least one non-test .go; (2) it changes at most 6 files; (3) exactly one package contains both changed tests and changed non-test code -- that package is the tested package; and (4) the withheld oracle DISCRIMINATES, meaning `go test ./<pkg>/` FAILS at the parent commit with only the fix's test files restored, and PASSES at the accepted fix. Criterion (4) is the instrument-capability check: an oracle that passes pre-fix would score any candidate CORRECT, including one that changed nothing. Eligible commits are grouped by tested package in order of first appearance; packages with fewer than two eligible commits are excluded because they cannot form a linked later-task specimen. From each remaining package the EARLIEST eligible commit is a seed and the NEXT later one is its linked task, until 10 tasks are selected. Task statements are written from the pre-fix state and the commit subject, stating the problem and never the implementation.

calibration.statement: Known failure: the six-cycle inspection that never converged (PR #62). Instrument check only.
Known win: the first end-to-end autonomous self-repair (PR #79/#80). Instrument check only.

tasks.statement: The transcript view in internal/tui cannot be scrolled: long output runs off the top and there is no way to reach earlier lines. Make the transcript scrollable.
Scrolling in the transcript view does not respond to the keys and the mouse wheel people actually use. Make it respond to the ordinary scrolling inputs.
internal/mcpconfig cannot describe an MCP server configuration for the architect. Give it the configuration model the architect needs.
internal/mcpconfig assumes what tools the MCP server exposes rather than reporting the allowlist the server was actually configured with. Report what is configured.
Task outcomes are never reported to the behavioral service. Report them.
internal/behavioral does not consult the behavioral gate before proceeding, and an absent answer must never be read as permission. Consult it, and fail closed on silence.
The push guard leaks into the candidate worktree, and doctor does not say how to fix what it reports. Keep the guard out of the candidate and make doctor actionable.
doctor reports a provider as ready when it is merely authenticated. Authentication is not readiness; report the difference.
The reviewer does not see files the worker created, only files it modified. The reviewer must judge the whole candidate.

The read-only observation lane measures the governed checkout with a git command that can itself write to that repository. A checker for a read-only lane must not become the write it is trying to detect.
